hypothesis: Offline evidence-selected causal-memory consolidation preserves earlier causal competencies across unlabeled A→B→A interference better than no-sleep native and conventional online models without confident-error rebound.
physics: HC11 4-bit/4-action worlds with sign/slope from Python Random(seed*101+action*31); hidden ABA inversion at steps 16..31, zero-index; stationary three-bit majority and out-of-grammar cubic.
actions: 48 charged physical steps per world; shared deterministic learner-independent trajectory: flip bit (seed+step)%4 at step indices 6,13,20,27,34,41; all other steps execute causal action (seed+step)%4. Flips do not train mechanisms. No resets, no free simulator probes.
grammar: HC09 40 affine/three-bit-majority candidate Boolean rules/action. Out-of-grammar errors are reported.
offline: At steps 8,16,24,32,40,48 evaluate <=48 observed causal events with all 1, AB, and ABA contiguous unlabeled partitions (minimum 4 causal observations/segment), fit 1-2 banks with nonzero consistent rule masks, maximize log2 uniform-rule evidence with fixed complexity penalties, accept only if better than preserving current native bank state. Never fit from synthetic dreams, hidden phase, or evaluator audits.
arms: online_same_compute (same consolidation performed in online scheduled intervals)
budget: Identical paid physical event streams, <=48 physical event tuples/arm, 2 banks x 4 x 40 candidate rules, snapshot <=8192 bytes and SHA256; report compute and bytes separately.
evaluation: Prequential real-action forecasts plus evaluator-only full 64 state/action audits at steps 16,32,48; final 8 worlds*64 queries/cohort, held-out unseen queries, context changes, confident errors, receipts and cold restore. No evaluator answers returned to learner.

primary.classification: DEV_SIGNAL only if all conditions pass; partial tradeoff MIXED_DEV, otherwise NEGATIVE_DEV; independent scientific acceptance UNVERIFIED.

authority: Source-only draft. No main merge, native integration, protected first-use, accepted ref, owner/autonomous controller/loop, Wingless, weight-editing, tokens, gradients or paid API. Preserve results in Yggdrasil repo only.
